factual_sources.text:
Integrations

Northstar supports common data warehouse, ticketing, and workflow integrations through approved connectors and APIs. Sales Representatives should confirm exact integration support with Solutions Engineering.

Implementation Timeline

The typical implementation range is 6 to 10 weeks for standard deployments. Complex integrations or unusual data governance requirements may extend the timeline.

SLA Targets

| Customer Tier | Initial Response | Status Update Cadence | Target Resolution |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Enterprise | 1 business hour | Every 4 business hours | 2 business days |
| Growth | 4 business hours | Every business day | 5 business days |
| Standard | 1 business day | Every 2 business days | 10 business days |

The SLA clock starts when the customer provides enough detail to identify the affected workspace, workflow, or integration. Requests with missing identifiers should receive a clarification response, not a resolution promise.

Product Limitations

Northstar is not a replacement for a system of record, identity provider, ERP, or clinical decision system. Sales Representatives should not promise unsupported integrations, exact roadmap delivery dates, or customer-specific contract commitments.

Approved Talk Track

Northstar helps operations leaders see where work slows down, which approvals are delayed, and which data quality issues affect business reporting. Sales Representatives should avoid promising product roadmap commitments.
